description: turbo-tasks: take_effects reads and captures each effect on its own spawned task (spawn_in_current_task: the spawned future shares the calling task's state, as a local task does, so its reads stay the task's own and the task waits for it), instead of try_join on one future, where a capture that restores its file content from the persistent cache decompresses it on that one thread. Test: two captures that each hold their thread until both have arrived both meet
